import bpy, numpy as np, math, time
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
scene=bpy.context.scene
print('units',scene.unit_settings.system,scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
print('meshes',[(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons)) for o in scene.objects if o.type=='MESH'])
print('target',bpy.data.objects.get('Mesh_D17AB2'))

dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
geo={}

    local=np.array([v.co[:] for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
    mat=np.array(ev.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    verts=local @ mat[:3,:3].T + mat[:3,3]
    tris=np.array([t.vertices[:] for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64)
    edges=np.unique(np.sort(np.concatenate([tris[:,[0,1]],tris[:,[1,2]],tris[:,[2,0]]]),axis=1),axis=0)
    geo[obj.name]={'v':verts,'t':tris,'e':edges}
    print(obj.name,'evaluated',len(verts),len(tris),'bounds',verts.min(axis=0).tolist(),verts.max(axis=0).tolist(),'modifiers',[(m.name,m.type) for m in obj.modifiers])

def point_triangle_min(points,triangles):
    p=points[:,None,:]; a=triangles[None,:,0,:]; b=triangles[None,:,1,:]; c=triangles[None,:,2,:]
    ab=b-a; ac=c-a; normal=np.cross(ab,ac); nn=np.sum(normal*normal,axis=-1)
    offset=np.sum((p-a)*normal,axis=-1)/nn
    q=p-offset[...,None]*normal
    aq=q-a; d00=np.sum(ab*ab,axis=-1); d01=np.sum(ab*ac,axis=-1); d11=np.sum(ac*ac,axis=-1)
    d20=np.sum(aq*ab,axis=-1); d21=np.sum(aq*ac,axis=-1); denom=d00*d11-d01*d01
    u=(d11*d20-d01*d21)/denom; v=(d00*d21-d01*d20)/denom
    inside=(u>=-1e-13)&(v>=-1e-13)&(u+v<=1+1e-13)
    dd=np.sum((p-q)**2,axis=-1); dd[~inside]=np.inf
    idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dd),dd.shape)

        r=start+np.clip(t,0,1)[...,None]*edge
